# BMLP - Blank Mind Logical Protocol
> A sovereign, zero-assumption recursive audit framework that separates Knowledge (static residue) from Intelligence (dynamic generative act). The missing machine-readable evidence layer for EU AI Act enforcement (Aug 2, 2026), NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001.

## Purpose
BMLP provides builder-independent audit evidence in OSCAL-compatible format. It exposes Systemic Cognitive Collapse.
